computation.reason: Requires authenticated data, cutoff, support, candidate and posterior/poll bindings plus a new joint forecast. Only ordinary D/R race probabilities are supported; no custom chamber adapter or SiteGround execution service exists.
requiredSteps: Bind and verify the exact current source data, cutoff, support, candidates and posterior/poll evidence.
Fit or import one compatible joint aggregate law and generate a current forecast.
Validate and save race probabilities; chamber distributions require a separate unsupported adapter.

evidence.implementation: Experimental ordinary D/R aggregate implementation is cataloged; the component factory is not a frozen site resolver.
evidence.numerical: Historical-parameter fitting passed numerical diagnostics for the four experimental arms; this is not a current forecast.
evidence.predictive: Some 2018 prediction cells are sealed, but the matched historical matrix is incomplete and no 2026 forecast has been sampled.
evidence.scope: Ordinary D/R aggregate race probabilities only. There is no custom full-chamber adapter or SiteGround execution service.
